title: Steps
description: A navigation bar that guides users through the steps of a task.
whenToUse: When a given task is complicated or has a certain sequence in the series of subtasks, we can decompose it into several steps to make things easier.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: The most basic step bar. Use the `variant` property to set different styles and `size` to control the size.

examples.name: Error status
examples.description: By using `status` of `Steps`, you can specify the state for current step.

examples.name: Vertical
examples.description: A simple step bar in the vertical orientation.

examples.name: Clickable
Panel Steps
With icon
examples.description: You can use your own custom icons by setting the property `icon` for `items`.

examples.name: Title Placement and Progress
examples.description: Use `titlePlacement` to set the label position and display the progress through `percent`.

examples.name: Max Count
examples.description: Use `maxCount` to limit visible steps. Hidden ranges are collapsed into ellipsis steps.

examples.name: Dot Style
Navigation Steps
Inline Steps
examples.description: Inline type steps, suitable for displaying the process and current state of the object in the list content scene.

examples.name: Inline Style Combination
examples.description: Inline step bar modifies the style and aligns through `offset`.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of Steps by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.

  • root
    根元素，包含 flex 布局、禁止换行、对齐方式、CSS 变量等步骤条容器的基础样式
  • item
    步骤项元素，包含 flex 布局、相对定位等单个步骤项的基础容器样式
  • itemWrapper
    步骤项内裹元素，包含 flex 布局、禁止换行、顶部内边距等步骤项内容的包装样式
  • itemIcon
    步骤项图标元素，包含图标的尺寸、定位、字体大小等图标显示相关样式
  • itemHeader
    步骤项头部元素，包含 flex 布局、禁止换行、对齐方式等头部区域的布局样式
  • itemTitle
    步骤项标题元素，包含颜色、字体大小、行高、文字换行、过渡动画等标题文字样式
  • itemSubtitle
    步骤项副标题元素，包含颜色、字体权重、字体大小、行高、外边距、文字换行等副标题样式
  • itemSection
    步骤项区域元素，包含步骤项内容区域的布局和样式
  • itemContent
    步骤项内容元素，包含颜色、字体大小、行高、文字换行、过渡动画等内容文字样式
  • itemRail
    步骤项连接线元素，包含边框样式、边框宽度、过渡动画等连接线的样式
